messages:
tess (PM): quick thread to resolve three unresolved contract items before we freeze Dedicated v1: burst pricing amortization, autoscale grace multiplier, and cross-region spillover billing. need decision by EOD Fri.

vikram (Eng): quick context: autoscale will have a 'graceMultiplier' that multiplies requested headroom for short windows to avoid flip-flop. default=1.5x for 30s. technically cheap to implement but we should make it tunable per-pool.

mina (SRE): ops note: the graceMultiplier reduces thrash but increases temporary GPU usage. must pair with a budget cap and an emergency throttle circuit if cluster util > 86%.

olga (Sales): customers asked for transparent math: how burst tokens map to invoice lines across regions (multi-region tenants). they want predictable monthly caps, not surprise spikes.

dennis (Legal): we need contract language for "burst amortization window" (how we bill burst across billing periods). prefer conservative wording: "Burst usage may be amortized over the billing month; see invoice detail."

tess (PM): proposal: 1) billing: burst tokens consumed are billed in-window; if cross-period spillover occurs we prorate to the period where majority of CPU consumed (>50%); 2) amortization: allow a 24-hour smoothing window to avoid microbilling for short test spikes; 3) autoscale: default graceMultiplier=1.5x, tunable per-pool, safety cap per-tenant.

vikram (Eng): implementation detail: token accounting should attach a "region_hint" and a receipt id so billing can later attribute. sample proto: `burst_event { tenant_id, pool_id, tokens, region_hint, started_at, ended_at }`

mina (SRE): telemetry needs: `burst_event_id, region, tokens_charged, tokens_consumed_local, spillover_to_region, p95_delta, cluster_util` - push to metrics stream. owner: @mina.

telemetrybot: Synthetic run 2026-07-01T06:00Z: multi-region test; region-A had prewarm -> p95 +3%, region-B no prewarm -> p95 +22%, cross-region spillover=0.9% of requests.

olga (Sales): pricing model ask: base reserved price + burst token price + optional hourly prewarm fee. propose tiers: standard burst token = $X per 1k tokens, prewarm per-hour = $Y/hr. finance to fill numbers.

dennis (Legal): SLA language draft suggestion: "Reserved capacity is guaranteed during the committed window. Burst is provided best-effort; in cross-region failover events Redwood may route traffic to alternate regions and bill accordingly. Detailed billing rules are available in the pricing appendix."

tess (PM): risks logged: 1) cross-region billing disputes; 2) customer confusion around amortization window; 3) cost spikes from aggressive graceMultiplier. mitigations: invoice preview, console explainer, and per-pool budget caps.

vikram (Eng): canary plan: enable graceMultiplier behind flag, run two enterprise tenants for 72h in staging replay, compare cost delta and p95 changes. automated rollback if p95 delta > 15% for >15m.

mina (SRE): ops plan: safety circuit -> if cluster util >86% OR burst spend rate > 120% expected, auto-disable non-premium bursts and alert. runbook owner: @mina by 2026-07-05.

olga (Sales): customer comms: I'll draft a one-pager: what burst means, amortization example, and invoice sample. will coordinate with finance + legal. owner: @olga by 2026-07-03.

dennis (Legal): I'll produce contract snippet for pricing appendix and a short clause on cross-region routing. owner: @dennis by 2026-07-04.

tess (PM): launch gates (v1): 1) runtime token check O(1) in hot path; 2) canary p95 delta < 12% for 72h; 3) invoice preview available for sample tenant; 4) runbook + safety circuit implemented.

vikram (Eng): owners: runtime accounting & graceMultiplier -> @vikram (PR by 2026-06-28). billing receipt proto -> @anna-bill (schema by 2026-06-26).

mina (SRE): telemetry + runbook owners acknowledged. will post dashboard mock in thread.

olga (Sales): thumbs?

vikram (Eng): :thumbsup:

mina (SRE): :thumbsup:

olga (Sales): :thumbsup: (flag: two customers will request hard preempt wording; will loop in sales engineering)

dennis (Legal): :thumbsup: (will add conservative language)

telemetrybot: Thread archived after 14 days of inactivity.
